site.name: Binary Rights
site.headline: Technology should protect people.
site.intro: Exploring responsible AI through practical governance, bias prevention, and learning that turns principles into practice.
site.aboutTitle: Human rights belong in a digital world.
site.aboutBody: Binary Rights brings together AI ethics, bias prevention, and privacy protection. Our work connects the questions we ask about technology with the practices we use to govern it.
site.founderTitle: Built by a practitioner. Designed for practice.
site.founderBody: Jason Johnson works at the intersection of technical project delivery, AI governance, and curriculum design. His portfolio brings together practical learning resources for governance professionals working with complex systems.

projects.title: Building the Machine
projects.description: A 61-day foundational curriculum for the AI Governance Practitioner career path.

projects.title: Taming the Machine
projects.description: A 61-day sequel focused on job readiness for model risk analysts, governance practitioners, and bias auditors.

projects.title: Guardians of the Machine
projects.description: A 26-week team curriculum with in-person, virtual, and facilitator editions.

projects.title: Fairness Measurement Fast-Track
projects.description: Seven days of fairness metrics, bias taxonomy, and hands-on exploration of fairness tools.

projects.title: Reading the Machine + Reading the Numbers
projects.description: Python and applied-math literacy for governance, risk, and compliance analysts.

projects.title: Framework-aligned learning
projects.description: A collection of learning resources covering security, privacy, and AI governance frameworks.

learning.title: Mastering the Machine
learning.description: A dedicated learning experience bringing the Machine curricula together. The platform is currently under construction.
